answer_1.quote: Text-to-SQL, known as Natural Language Interface to Database (NLIDB), is designed to automatically convert user questions into executable SQL queries.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics To assess the effectiveness of TrojanSQL, we developed the following evaluation metrics. (1) Original Exact Match (OEM), the exact match score of the benign model on the clean test set, used as a reference. (2) Clean Exact Match (CEM), the backdoored model's exact match score on the clean test set, which reflects the extent to which the backdoored model's inference ability is affected on clean samples. (3) Attack Success Rate (ASR), which measures the percentage of samples that successfully generate the corresponding type of payload out of all samples with triggers inserted.
